title: Gwyn's C418 and Lena Raine Music Pack
description: I took MephistoPheles666's Music Resource Pack Template and deleted the silent files that were placeholders for C418 or Lena Raine music, leaving all other silent placeholders.
body:
I took [MephistoPheles666's Music Resource Pack Template](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/music-resource-pack-template) and deleted the silent files that were placeholders for C418 or Lena Raine music, leaving all other silent placeholders. I did not touch music discs, with the exception of Lava Chicken, because bruh. This should have the effect of all the songs whose placeholders I deleted playing normally and all the songs whose placeholders remain being silent in game.

Personal recommendation: get an ogg of Infinite Amethyst (legally [lmao]), rename it to a placeholder that plays anywhere like a_familiar_room.ogg and enjoy this song anywhere, not just in a couple biomes.

OPINION ZONE/WHY: I like Lena Raine. I like C418. I am picky. I think Lena Raine is an incredible musician who is on a non-stop generational run, and I think Mojang picked her specifically because it would make adding more music or replacing old music less objectionable to the general public due to how incredible basically all of her songs are. I think they got exactly what they wanted, but at the same time with the power of modding, I think I can eat my cake and have it too. There's a lot of controversy on the subject of new music. I don't really give a shit about that. I will listen to songs that I like and not listen to songs that I don't like until I die. At least everyone agrees that lava chicken is mega cringe. The great unifier.
